gate:
Picture the unguarded attention a small child brings to a strange object, the wide open looking with no defence in it. That is the texture of this code. The world arrives clean. Suffering, beauty, the ordinary face of a stranger on a bus, all of it lands without the usual filters of suspicion or grievance. A person carrying this often feels a kind of universal love as weather inside them, sometimes so bright it is uncomfortable, sometimes so steady it confuses the people around them who expect cynicism and find none.

The misread is to call this naive, to assume innocence means unaware. It is not the same thing. The innocence here is what remains after a person has seen what the world contains and still chooses to love it anyway. The capacity to be moved is the gift. The risk is mistaking openness for absence of discernment, and giving the love to anything that asks.
centre_field:
This love is wired straight into the part of you that holds who you are and which way your life is pointed. That placement is the whole teaching. The love is not a personality trait floating somewhere in the system, a soft sweetness layered on top of an otherwise ordinary self. It is bound to identity itself. To live this code is to live from the part of you that knows everyone is, underneath, the same kind of luminous thing.

When that self is trusted, the love is clear and the direction it sets is clear with it. When a person tries to perform a stricter or sharper self, something borrowed from a world that rewards edges, the love grows cloudy and the heading wanders. The identity and the love rise and fall together. Protect one and you protect the other.
channel:
On its own this love can stay a wide gentle field, beautiful, but easily dispersed across everything and nothing. It needs an impact to become useful. What this code reaches for is the other half of itself, the part of a person built for the sudden break, the accident, the loss, the moment the floor drops out. The older traditions called that meeting an initiation, and the name still fits.

Shock is what gives the love its edge. The break wakes it into focused presence and lets it do real work in a real life. Joined to its partner, this becomes the strange medicine the lineages spoke of, the kind of love that walks toward a person at the worst moment of their life and does not flinch. Without the impact, the innocence is only a mood. With it, the love becomes the thing that holds when nothing else can.
